# Stitch round 1 — TradeMentor dashboard

**First design in this project not drawn by hand.** Generated by Stitch (Google's
UI generator, Gemini 3.1 Pro) from a prompt carrying the real product content, the
three named references — Zerodha Kite, Dhan, Tickertape — and the colour rules.

Stitch project `7592233293884048749` · screen `4ea0111a24e8409c9415aace20a780a6`.
`01-dashboard-stitch.html` is the generated source, downloaded unmodified.

---

## What it got right

**The design system it derived is closer to the references than anything hand-built
across five previous attempts.** It read the brief and produced:

```
primary   #387ED1   UI chrome only          ← Zerodha blue
success   #4CAF50   profitable trades only
danger    #EB5757   losses and risk only
caution   #F2994A
surface   #1F1F1F on #0C0C0C
radius    4px standard, 8px maximum
shadows   none — "tonal layering and low-contrast outlines"
type      Inter, 500 headers / 400 body, tabular-nums on all figures
tables    horizontal dividers only, no vertical borders
```

Two structural moves worth keeping regardless of what happens next:

**The two-column split.** Alerts on the left, open positions as a narrower right rail.
Every hand-built attempt stacked everything full width and left the right third of a
1440px screen empty below the hero. This uses the width.

**The metric row reads as instrument panel.** Four boxes, one carrying a thin red
progress bar for loss budget — the budget is the only metric with a ceiling, so it is
the only one that gets a bar. That distinction was not in the prompt.

---

## What it got wrong

**1 · The active navigation item is solid green.** The prompt stated that green is
reserved exclusively for money gained and must never be UI chrome. Stitch used it for
the selected nav anyway, which is the exact confusion the rule exists to prevent — on
a screen where green already means "profit", a green nav pill competes with the P&L.

**2 · The DANGER badge is unreadable.** Red text on a red fill. It appears twice, on
the two most serious alerts on the page.

**3 · It altered the data.** BANKNIFTY quantity rendered as `15` where the source says
`100`, and the positions table dropped Entry, LTP and Chg% entirely — three of six
columns gone. For a product whose entire claim is "we show you what actually happened",
a generator that quietly edits figures is a correctness problem, not a style one.

**4 · Blue is almost absent.** Despite being specified as the accent, it survives only
on the "View all" link.

---

## Where this leaves it

Not shippable, and not a finished design. But it is the first artefact in this project
produced by something other than my own taste, and points 1–4 are all correctable in a
prompt rather than requiring a rebuild.

**A variant pass was attempted** with those four defects written as explicit
corrections plus three divergent layout briefs. The call timed out and produced no
screens; it needs re-running.

**Still missing: Kite itself.** `zerodha.com` and `kite.zerodha.com` are blocked by the
browser's safety restrictions, so the most important of the three references has only
ever been read as a third-party spec, never seen. Screenshots would materially improve
the next prompt.
